resize-delivery-promises.scope: Positive integer order units, nonnegative revised quantity. Prior schedule quantities are already sorted by date then creation. The stock factor is a positive whole number.

remaining-invoice-quantity.scope: Normal positive order, allowance gate passed, all measures in integral order units. Net billed already includes signed returns and conversion.

issue-proforma.scope: Readable source, issue authority, single amount-basis line, invoice currency cents, no percentage charges. One fixed freight and one fixed net discount. Examples divide at exact cents.

price-fixed-plan.scope: Proration enabled, fixed plan, positive period length, no tax/discount, elapsed_days includes processing day. Cents divide exactly in these cases.

session-cash.scope: Interactive count, change matches cash; input tender totals are gross, refund is already signed, card has no refund. All monetary quantities are cents.

close-session-membership.scope: Opening and source validations passed. Simple fixture uses disjoint receipt names for the two invoice kinds. Eligible set is read again at submission.

repeat-free-units.scope: Already qualified recursive nontransaction rule on paid matching rows; configured reward positive. Rounded whole-block mode.

earn-points.scope: Program active and divisor already selected. Cents inputs, 100 minor units per whole currency unit. Redemption amount is truncated to whole major units before subtraction.

allocate-redeemed-lots.scope: Observed signed-sum allocation. Two earning lots in increasing expiry order. Both meet date/party/company conditions. Earlier redemption is a negative amount against first lot. Invoice amount permits the request.

service-invoice.scope: Readable timesheet, optional service item is supplied. Positive remaining hours in supported accepted cases. Billing is in integer cents at exact division for these fixtures.

admit-appointment.scope: All date, grid, verification and authorization gates passed. Minute offsets are site-local on the same day; all existing intervals have the configured duration. States Open, Closed, Unverified.

select-service-agreement.scope: Eligible identifiers ordered by customer/group/territory/specificity then defaults. Already-selected identifier can be null.

retry-bulk-conversion.scope: One eligible previously failed log, previously untried, authorized retry. Later success uses same source and kind-pair; otherwise worker outcome determines new log status.

resolve-code-version.scope: One canonical URI and positive integer publisher versions, after exact document-name lookup. Versions are text. An explicitly selected code list must exist.

campaign-efficiency.scope: Preselected nonempty lead cohort. Orders counts quotations with ordered or partially-ordered status. Inputs chosen for integral percentages.

weighted-approval-discount.scope: Nonnegative quantities, all prices in common base currency cents. Specimens produce exact basis points. Subject and approver matching are separate operations.

quote-choice-set.scope: Single choice group with main and alternative, plus one simple service row. All stocks are in the same unit. Zero ordered flags denote absent row in the submitted links for these fixtures.
